classification_definitions.integration: Material real component/API/network/process/store/runtime or production output read/write boundary supports an observable assertion.
classification_definitions.unit: Core assertion is local predicate/control-flow/vector or synthetic dependency record; incidental files/sockets/broker fixture side effects do not promote it.
classification_definitions.mixed: Independent unit-only assertion block coexists with materially asserted real boundary; both retained.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Source/mapping ambiguity or source-visible contradiction prevents credit; blocked later assertions explicitly uncredited.

qualification_limits: Runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION. No compilation, test pass or runtime qualification claimed.

No source/repository/ledger mutation, Go/build/test/formatter/lint/benchmark/helper execution, process/resource probes, cloud, privilege, signing/crypto, TerraBase execution or download occurred. Only canonical file/Git reads and metadata hashing/serialization.

fenceLease journal Read/Commit and authority are synthetic test memory; real fenceKV is a separate JetStream store. Status or fence records qualify only where the target assertion materially reads/writes that actual store.

Recovery fixtures directly call upstream server.NewServer and loopback nats.Connect with username/password/controller grants; they do not call natscell.Start, in-process transport, mTLS/JWT or actual production authority leases. Recovery SSH probe callback is injected; no actual OCI/SSH access or cloud action.

Mesh health fixture proves successful local UDP DNS lookup before a structural endpoint hold; it proves no service traffic on selected IP, tunnel, NetBird daemon or host health. Listener callback-order root asserts no actual socket usability/closure.

Removal/return use real local status/fence KV with fake journal authority, host reports, healthy callbacks and load-balancer effects. No real workload, backend health, OCI or failover durability inferred.

Artifact preflight uses tiny test ELF bytes staged in local object store and verified by production readers. No vendor download, real NetBird binary execution or image qualification. Pin image-input fixture is input only.

All20 original/current raw hashes match historical mapping exactly; no drift. All safety/negative/trust/signature/no-dial/fencing/order/retry/retention obligations remain. No ledger/count/deletion/retirement/qualification/completion promotion.

findings.detail: Journal roots use fake authority memory. Recovery uses direct upstream broker with real loopback RPC but fake SSH probe. Explicit mixed blocks keep local crypto/guard obligations alongside status/fence-store effects.
